styleSelection.reason: Requested pen plus light wash: roof junctions, wall corners, narrow cypresses and branching trunks carry structure in fine black ink; connected transparent green and ochre washes carry the hillside values.

families.referenceCue: The right-hand stepped group has terracotta roofs, pale ochre sunlit walls, cool left faces and dark openings. Architecture recipe: opening structure, connected light wall planes, dry, cross-plane shadow glaze, selective closing junctions.
Small distant village roofs and lavender shaded walls above the canopy: pale planar wash and fewer, lighter structural pen lines; omit masonry texture.
Broad golden terrace walls and pale paths at upper left; connected watery ochre wash, protected sun flecks, sparse wall junctions in ink.

Interlocking olive and yellow-green crowns have broad irregular masses and connected deep green shadow groups. Foliage recipe: pale connected mass, full dry, coherent shadow glaze; no leaf dots or complete canopy outlines.
Large yellow-green foreground crown with a dark tapering trunk and spreading branches. Light mass and dry shadow groups; line-scale trunk and branches in directional black pen, no leaf stipple.

Tall narrow dark cypress silhouettes anchor the village and overlap terraces. Pale green foundation, dry connected blue-green shadow shape, few tapered structural lines; preserve the neighboring golden wall.
Upper right distance is blue-grey hill and subdued small green crowns, with no sky. One pale continuous cool wash; softer low contrast edges and little pen detail.
Broken golden paths and pale stone gaps weave between foreground olive crowns. Thin warm ground wash, paper glints, and a dry shadow glaze crossing ground and vegetation at tree feet.
